messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — we need final copy for Hosted/Dedicated/Private landing pages by EOD today for launch posts + webinar. Drafts in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: On it. I'll PR copy for Hosted first, then Dedicated. Can we keep the hero consistent but tweak CTA and compliance blurb for Private?

taylor: +1. For webinar signups we should test 'Get started' vs 'Request demo' — enterprise tends to prefer demo.

sri: FYI benchmarks: latency/cost blurb needs a small callout referencing our 99th %-tile SLA. See benchmark notes in the figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder

jamie: I'd shorten the technical hero line. Customer-facing suggestion: "Predictable LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments" -> maybe "Predictable, high-performance LLM inference — hosted, reserved, or private."

morgan: Good. Can someone draft 3 short variants for each hero (hosted,dedicated,private)? 2 lines max. I'll assemble for comms.

alex: Drafts:
Hosted: "Ship LLM features fast with our hosted API — low-latency, pay-as-you-go."
Dedicated: "Predictable throughput with reserved GPU pools and SLA-backed performance."
Private: "Full control and compliance: private VPC and on-prem inference."

sri: Put microproof under each: Hosted: "No-commit instant access"; Dedicated: "Reserved capacity, burstable"; Private: "VPC, KMS, audit logs"

taylor: For launch posts: headline + 3 bullets + webinar CTA. We should also route inbound leads: self-serve signups -> onboarding flow; demo requests -> AE queue; compliance queries -> solutions_eng. Add tags in form.

jamie: Routing rules: 
- demo -> sales@redwood.com + /sales form tag
- compliance -> solutions-eng@redwood + trust-signal
- self-serve -> product-onboard@redwood

morgan: Can someone update the google doc with routing mapping and form IDs? I'll sync with ops.

deploy-bot: Webinar slot booked: Apr 15 09:00 PT — registration page up: https://redwood.com/webinar/fast-inference

alex: I'll write the webinar blurb: "See how we reduce per-token cost with batching and KV caching — live bench demo and customer case study."

sri: Add benchmarking snippet we can screenshot in posts: "3x cost reduction on long-tail chat workloads vs baseline" — need approval from product.

morgan: Product approval scheduled at 3pm. If approved, we push copy to staging and queue launch posts for Apr 10-12.

taylor: Quick check on CTAs for private page: should be "Contact sales" or "Request private trial"? Recommend "Request private trial" to capture intent.

jamie: +1 "Request private trial" and route to solutions-eng.

morgan: Great — plan set. I'll tick items in the doc and ping later. :thumbsup:

alex: Leaving small TODOs in doc: screenshot benchmarks, add form IDs, create short social snippets (3 variations).

taylor: I'll take social snippets. 1-2 sentences each.

morgan: Thanks everyone. End of thread.
